name: andaxi-mini-crm
description: Mini-CRM pentru Andaxi: clienti, abonamente recurente (gazduire/mentenanta) si ore de interventie

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
